title: Corrupt Officer
desc: Move the Marshall. Steal 1 resource card from the owner of an adjacent settlement or city.

title: New Routes
desc: Place 2 new trails as if you just built them.

title: Bumper Harvest
desc:
Take any 2 resources from the bank.
Add them to your hand. They can be 2 of the same or 2 different resources.

title: Corner the Market
desc: When you play this card announce 1 type of resource. All other players must give you all their resource cards of that type.

title: Kingpin
desc:
2 Points!
The first player to play 3 Corrupt Officers gets this card. Another player who plays more Corrupt Officers takes this card.

title: Longest Run
desc:
2 Points!
This card goes to the player with the longest unbroken trail of atleast 5 segments. Another player who builds a longer trail takes this card.
